tw: Kron's drawing of a king draws a straw from the drawer and sings.
twc: Kron 画的国王从抽屉里抽出一根吸管，还唱起了歌。
hint: 画出来的国王自己活了。

tw: Kron finds it difficult to sniff fifty different gulls on a cliff.
twc: 在悬崖上挨个闻五十只不同的海鸥，Kron 觉得太难了。
hint: 闻到第五十只，鼻子罢工。

tw: "Is that a pink mink in the sink?" "I think so," Kron winks.
twc: “水池里是只粉色水貂吗？”“我想是。”Kron 眨眨眼。
hint: 他早知道，水貂是他放的。

tw: Kron stuffs nuts in his cheeks till his mouth can't shut, and the squirrels tut.
twc: Kron 往腮帮里塞坚果，塞到嘴都合不上，松鼠们直咂嘴。
hint: 抢松鼠的饭，被松鼠嫌弃。

tw: "Come, come!" Kron's cool mule must come to school and squash his stool.
twc: “来呀来呀！”Kron 的酷骡子非要来学校，还坐扁了他的凳子。

tw: "Take care!" Kron waves as the bear takes his chair and his pear to the fair.
twc: “保重！”Kron 挥手，熊扛着他的椅子拿着他的梨去赶集。

tw: Stuck on a plank in a tank of nine fish, Kron waves, "I'm fine thank you!"
twc: 困在九条鱼的鱼缸里的木板上，Kron 挥手：“我很好，谢谢！”

tw: "See you!" Kron waves to two blue bees who sail to sea in his shoe.
twc: “再见！”Kron 冲两只蓝蜜蜂挥手，它们坐着他的鞋出海了。

tw: Kron's hot pot froze to snow in the wood. "Not so good," he moans.
twc: Kron 的热汤在树林里冻成了雪，他哀叹：“不太好。”

tw: Kron's bite of the white pie crust is just right, so he bites all night.
twc: Kron 咬了一口白白的派皮，正合适，于是啃了一整夜。

tw: Kron bows low to show a slow crow around the snowy town.
twc: Kron 低头鞠躬，领着慢吞吞的乌鸦逛雪镇。

tw: Two otters, one bun: Kron gives it to one, and the other otter runs off with Kron.
twc: 两只水獭一个包子：Kron 给一只，另一只扛起他就跑。
hint: 没分到包子，就分走 Kron。

tw: Kron can play the piano with a banana while a llama in pajamas plays along.
twc: Kron 拿香蕉弹钢琴，一只穿睡衣的羊驼在旁边一起弹。
hint: 香蕉当手指，羊驼来伴奏。

tw: Kron and Phil the fish watch films on a hill till the popcorn spills.
twc: Kron 和小鱼菲尔在山坡上看电影，爆米花撒了一地。

tw: "Look out!" Kron shouts as a trout jumps out of the cook's book.
twc: “小心！”Kron 大喊，一条鳟鱼从厨师的书里跳了出来。

tw: Kron the driver drives five shivering divers to the river.
twc: 司机 Kron 开车送五个直打哆嗦的潜水员去河边。
hint: 乘客冷得抖，司机很得意。

tw: Kron's e-friend Bee sends a pen, and it pokes out of his screen.
twc: Kron 的网友小蜜蜂寄来一支笔，笔从屏幕里戳了出来。

tw: "Wait a minute!" Kron yells as eight mint sweets skate off his plate.
twc: “等一会儿！”Kron 大喊，八颗薄荷糖穿着冰鞋滑出了盘子。

tw: Kron and a goat go fishing in a boat and fish up a king's ring.
twc: Kron 和山羊坐船去钓鱼，钓上来一枚国王的戒指。

tw: "Don't worry!" Kron calls in a hurry, five furry pups stuffed in his coat.
twc: “别担心！”Kron 匆匆喊道，外套里塞着五只毛茸茸的小狗。
hint: 他越说别担心，越让人担心。
